description: FSAE / FSUK-scale pushrods, horizontal rocker axes, inboard coilovers, a T-bar ARB and a central heave element. Illustrative hardpoints.
FSAE / FSUK-scale pullrods, near-vertical rocker axes, low inboard coilovers, a T-bar ARB and a central heave element. Illustrative hardpoints.
IndyCar-inspired pushrods and near-vertical rockers with inboard coilovers, a transverse U-bar ARB and a central third element. Illustrative hardpoints.

Double-wishbone pushrod layout with horizontal rockers, coaxial torsion bars, separate dampers, a U-bar ARB and a rocker-to-rocker heave link. Shares an approximately 10-degree caster baseline with the pullrod layout.

F1-inspired pullrods mounted to the upper wishbones, with low horizontal rockers, coaxial torsion bars, separate transverse dampers, a T-bar ARB and a central heave element. Shares an approximately 10-degree caster baseline with the pushrod layout.
